title: Noetherianity of a finite-variable polynomial ring
statement: For every natural number $n$, the multivariable polynomial ring [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring] $\mathbf Z[x_1,\ldots,x_n]$ is Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]: every ideal in it is generated by finitely many elements.

source.place: Theorem MvPolynomial.isNoetherianRing_fin, lines 925--927, instantiated with the Noetherian commutative ring $\mathbf Z$.
